# Blaze — dependencies
#
# Generated by scanning every `import`/`from` in the codebase (not
# guessed from memory) and mapping each import name to its real PyPI
# package name where they differ (e.g. `import win32gui` comes from the
# `pywin32` package, not a package literally called `win32gui`).
#
# Setup:
#   python -m venv .venv
#   .venv\Scripts\activate        (Windows)   or   source .venv/bin/activate   (macOS/Linux)
#   pip install -r requirements.txt --break-system-packages   (only add that flag if pip complains
#                                                                about an externally-managed env)

# --- GUI ---
PySide6

# --- AI / LLM ---
groq

# --- Server (blaze_server.py) ---
fastapi
uvicorn
starlette
pydantic

# --- Google integration (google_auth.py) ---
google-auth-oauthlib
google-api-python-client
google-auth

# --- Spotify integration (spotify_auth.py) ---
spotipy

# --- Voice ---
pyttsx3
edge-tts
SpeechRecognition

# --- System stats / hardware (hw_stats-style modules) ---
psutil
GPUtil
pynvml          # NVIDIA GPU stats — safe to leave installed even without an NVIDIA GPU
plyer           # cross-platform notifications/UI helpers

# --- HTTP ---
requests

# --- Security / config ---
cryptography
python-dotenv

# --- Real-time phone mirroring (blaze/gui/phone_mirror.py) ---
av              # PyAV — H.264 decode for the live screen-mirror stream

# --- Windows-only (no-ops / unavailable on macOS & Linux, code already guards for this) ---
pywin32; sys_platform == "win32"    # provides win32gui, win32con, win32com, pythoncom
WMI; sys_platform == "win32"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOT installable via pip — separate tools this code shells out to:
#   adb     Android SDK Platform Tools — required for any phone-mirror/
#           android-control feature. https://developer.android.com/tools/releases/platform-tools
#           Must be on PATH.
#   scrcpy  Optional — only used by the legacy embedded-window mirror path
#           (opt-in via BLAZE_ENABLE_SCRCPY_EMBED=1), not the default PyAV
#           streaming path. github.com/Genymobile/scrcpy — must be on PATH.
# FFmpeg itself is NOT a separate requirement — the `av` package above
# bundles the FFmpeg decoding libraries it needs.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
